Notes: The request-adapt side cannot modify attributes on the
response-adapt side until the connection has been established with the
server.
ADAPT::timeout [<ctx>]
Get the timeout attribute for the current side
ADAPT::timeout [<ctx>] request
Get the timeout attribute for the request-adapt side
ADAPT::timeout [<ctx>] response
Get the timeout attribute for the response-adapt side
ADAPT::timeout [<ctx>] <number>
Sets the timeout attribute for the current side
ADAPT::timeout [<ctx>] request <number>
Sets the timeout attribute for the request-adapt side
ADAPT::timeout [<ctx>] response <number>
Sets the timeout attribute for the response-adapt side
